rules.title: Diabetes diagnosis required
rules.summary: Beneficiary must have diabetes mellitus diagnosis per ICD-10 code list.
rules.source_sentence: The beneficiary has diabetes mellitus (Refer to the ICD-10 code list in the LCD-related Policy Article for applicable diagnoses); and,

rules.title: Frequent BGM testing required
rules.summary: Beneficiary must have been using a BGM and performing frequent (four or more times a day) testing.
rules.source_sentence: The beneficiary has been using a BGM and performing frequent (four or more times a day) testing; and,

rules.title: Insulin-treated with multiple daily injections or CSII pump
rules.summary: Beneficiary must be insulin-treated with multiple (three or more) daily injections of insulin or a Medicare-covered CSII pump.
rules.source_sentence: The beneficiary is insulin-treated with multiple (three or more) daily injections of insulin or a Medicare-covered continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII) pump; and,

rules.title: Regimen requires frequent adjustment
rules.summary: Beneficiary's insulin treatment regimen requires frequent adjustment by the beneficiary on the basis of BGM or CGM testing results.
rules.source_sentence: The beneficiary's insulin treatment regimen requires frequent adjustment by the beneficiary on the basis of BGM or CGM testing results; and,

rules.title: In-person visit within 6 months prior to ordering
rules.summary: Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1-4) above are met.
rules.source_sentence: Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1-4) above are met; and,

rules.title: In-person visit every 6 months after initial prescription
rules.summary: Every six (6) months following the initial prescription of the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to assess adherence to their CGM regimen and diabetes treatment plan.
rules.source_sentence: Every six (6) months following the initial prescription of the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to assess adherence to their CGM regimen and diabetes treatment plan.

rules.title: K0553 supply allowance units per 30 days
rules.summary: Only one (1) UOS of code K0553 may be billed to the DME MACs at a time. Billing more than 1 UOS per 30 days of code K0553 will be denied as not reasonable and necessary.
rules.source_sentence: Only one (1) UOS of code K0553 may be billed to the DME MACs at a time. Billing more than 1 UOS per 30 days of code K0553 will be denied as not reasonable and necessary.

rules.title: BGM and supplies not covered with CGM
rules.summary: Claims for a BGM and related supplies, billed in addition to an approved CGM device (code K0554) and associated supply allowance (code K0553), will be denied.
rules.source_sentence: Claims for a BGM and related supplies, billed in addition to an approved CGM device (code K0554) and associated supply allowance (code K0553), will be denied.

rules.title: PDAC listing required for K0554
rules.summary: Continuous Glucose Monitor systems that have not been reviewed and listed on the Product Classification List for HCPCS code K0554 will be denied as incorrect coding.
rules.source_sentence: Continuous Glucose Monitor systems that have not been reviewed and listed on the Product Classification List for HCPCS code K0554 will be denied as incorrect coding.
